Package bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.model

Class FlightBookingSystem

java.lang.Object
bcu.cmp5332.bookingsystem.model.FlightBookingSystem
public class FlightBookingSystem extends Object
The main coordination class for the booking system. It manages the collections of flights and customers and ensures all business rules (like capacity and uniqueness) are followed.
